title: 1792 – The One-Eyed King: mission development cards

scope.meaning: These cards define the next development increment for inventoried prototypes. They do not add playable sequences or certify their new features as implemented.
scope.status_policy: development_status refers to the proposed increment only. baseline describes the ledger snapshot. implementation_receipt stays null until the increment has a concrete reviewed revision and verification.
scope.count_policy: Child beats, alternate approaches, presentations, mechanics and source retellings are not extra missions. The 28-entry youth slate includes one implemented adaptation alias and 27 planned entries.
scope.history_policy: Keep legends, miracles, conflicting allegations and dramatic invention. Preserve the ledger’s historical basis beside every card. Player choice may alter local care, communication or immediate outcomes without silently proving an allegation or overwriting a declared fixed historical endpoint.
scope.cinematic_policy: Build cinema from playable approach, staging, sound, performance and consequential action. A proposed cinematic moment is not a claim that cinematics, voice, animation or finished art already exist.
scope.verification_policy: Acceptance criteria are intended pass conditions for future implementation. This authoring pass checks coverage and consistency only; it does not rerun the games on their separate draft branches.

cards.title: Learning the yard

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a child find his own bearings in a household already full of adult purposes?
cards.playable_objective: Walk the yard, turn deliberately toward its landmarks, and find the courier without losing control of movement.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Choose the first landmark to inspect; the lead-in makes the message a discoverable interruption rather than another unrelated instruction.
cards.local_consequence: The next objective names the courier and where to find him; exploration creates no hidden literacy or political knowledge.
cards.cinematic_moment: Hooves, work and voices establish ordinary household life before a waiting courier cuts across it.
cards.next_implementation_task: Improve the orientation lead-in, landmark staging and objective text that hands the player into HOME-002.
cards.acceptance_criterion: A fresh start explains walk and look, completion leads visibly to the courier, and pausing or repeating an interaction cannot skip the message lesson.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Textual staging and prototype actors; cinematic animation, voice and final art remain planned.

cards.title: The sealed message

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: What does a future ruler do when the words of an order and the account of its bearer leave uncertainty?
cards.playable_objective: Receive the sealed message, hear courier and steward, and decide how to take the uncertain account to the trainer.
cards.encounter_or_choice: After both initial accounts, ask the steward to proceed directly to the trainer or first return to the courier for clarification; existing training stays available.
cards.local_consequence: The journal keeps the selected approach, any clarification actually heard, and the trainer’s receipt; neither path discovers a hidden culprit or grants a risk modifier.
cards.cinematic_moment: The seal remains visible in the child’s hand while an older voice supplies its meaning; the reply is the child’s first deliberate public decision.
cards.next_implementation_task: Add the optional post-reading conversation, clarification interaction, trainer acknowledgment, remembered receipt and matching objective cues.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both approaches can reach their trainer acknowledgment, clarification is credited only after hearing it, repeat interactions do not duplicate receipts, and normal riding progression remains available.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

cards.title: First riding gates

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the child turn confidence into control when the horse has momentum of its own?
cards.playable_objective: Mount, pass the three gates in order, brake, and dismount on clear ground.
cards.encounter_or_choice: A trainer calls for a controlled approach to the last gate; the player can slow early or recover after overshooting.
cards.local_consequence: Feedback distinguishes missing a gate from losing control and returns the rider to the unfinished part without awarding an advanced horsecraft flag.
cards.cinematic_moment: The courtyard opens into a longer sightline as the horse accelerates, then the last gate tightens the composition around a deliberate stop.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage a readable entry and stopping area, add contextual trainer reactions, and make the next valid gate apparent from horseback.
cards.acceptance_criterion: A first-time player can identify the next gate and stopping requirement; wrong-order passage cannot complete the course and a safe retry preserves completed gates.

cards.title: Guard and counter

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Will the child strike in anger or wait for the opening his teacher has exposed?
cards.playable_objective: Read two telegraphed blows, hold guard, recover and counter within the trainer’s opening.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Early swings meet a guarded response; a patient counter produces a clear change in the trainer’s stance.
cards.local_consequence: The lesson records one learned sequence and gives specific corrective feedback without practice damage or an arbitrary damage upgrade.
cards.cinematic_moment: The sound of the yard falls behind the rhythm of two practice blows; the teacher briefly lowers his weapon after a clean counter.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give each practice phase distinct posture, caption and sound cues, with recovery feedback tied to the actual strike window.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Early, late and correctly timed counters receive distinct feedback; the lesson finishes only after the required guards and counter, with no damage in practice.

cards.title: Tracks beyond Home

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Can observation overcome the urge to hurry toward a prize?
cards.playable_objective: Follow three physical traces and quietly reach an observation position beside the quarry.
cards.encounter_or_choice: A tempting direct line passes the later trace but cannot replace examining the earlier evidence; noisy approach calls for a calmer second attempt.
cards.local_consequence: The remembered trail contains only examined traces; completion records observation of the animal, not a kill or harvested item.
cards.cinematic_moment: Reeds and dry scrub part just enough for a first distant glimpse; the final approach holds on the animal’s breathing and the player’s footsteps.
cards.next_implementation_task: Make the three traces visually distinct, use terrain to connect their sightlines, and replace generic guidance with evidence-specific observations.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Each trace requires proximity and eye-level visibility, out-of-order inspection explains what is missing, and the final approach cannot complete through a wall or while rushing.

cards.title: The return-path ambush

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the child bring his lessons to bear when the return home becomes dangerous?
cards.playable_objective: Recognize the ambush, create space by movement or a guarded counter, and reach the courtyard alive.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Escape immediately or face the attacker long enough to open a safer retreat; mounted escape remains a supported route.
cards.local_consequence: The aftermath receives only the assault details the player actually observed; reaching safety does not identify the attacker’s employer.
cards.cinematic_moment: The familiar return bend suddenly conceals movement; the courtyard’s light becomes a practical destination while footsteps close behind.
cards.next_implementation_task: Rework the bend’s approach and escape sightline, give the assailant an unmistakable warning tell, and stage the household’s arrival response.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both immediate escape and guard-counter retreat are viable, failed attempts restart the encounter without corrupting the household state, and unseen identity information is never added.

cards.title: The household inquiry

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.

cards.dramatic_question: Who gets to shape the account of an attack before the child has understood it himself?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the household accounts, choose escort or independent inquiry, inspect the bend and return a bounded report.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Raj Kaur’s offer makes protection useful but socially visible; investigating alone changes the exchange and presence at the bend.
cards.local_consequence: The report retains chosen approach and inspected evidence, while uncertainty survives both routes and neither produces a culprit.
cards.cinematic_moment: The same bend is quieter on the return visit; a guard’s presence, or its absence, changes the distance between the child and the road.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the inquiry a staged household discussion, branch-specific companion blocking and a final report assembled from heard and seen details.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both inquiry routes reach a distinct acknowledgment, omitted evidence is not reported as seen, and restoring the checkpoint restores the companion and chosen route together.

cards.title: Four-food delivery

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the young heir keep an ordinary promise when rank does not carry the food for him?
cards.playable_objective: Accept the four-food contract, collect its actual cargo and deliver it to the market recipient.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Decide whether to check the delivery terms with the household before setting off; the recipient responds to the real cargo rather than the player’s title.
cards.local_consequence: The existing finite payment remains attached to one successful handover; a failed attempt leaves a clear account of missing cargo.
cards.cinematic_moment: A busy market makes room for a small, practical exchange: a tally, a handover, and a recipient who returns immediately to work.
cards.next_implementation_task: Author a short contract briefing, show cargo and recipient spatially, and stage the single delivery acknowledgment.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Exactly four food leave the carried supply on success, payout occurs once, and save/load before or after handover cannot repeat the reward.

cards.title: Bring the carrier Home

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Does giving an escort order matter if the person entrusted to you cannot keep up?
cards.playable_objective: Meet the return carrier, keep physical contact during the journey, and check the same carrier and cargo into Home.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Stop and regroup when the carrier is separated or continue ahead and return to recover contact; the disputed crossing remains an optional route of this arc.
cards.local_consequence: Arrival is earned by the carrier’s physical return, with one existing supply check-in and no additional cargo for alternate paths.
cards.cinematic_moment: At the gate the child turns back; the laden carrier is still crossing the open road and the escort must wait.
cards.next_implementation_task: Add readable lost-contact and regroup behavior, an arrival blocking pass, and a shared handover used by the ordinary and disputed routes.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Reaching Home alone cannot finish; a separated carrier can be recovered, and every route resolves the same one-time check-in.

cards.title: Water for the household

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Will the heir notice how much labor sits beneath the household’s ordinary comfort?
cards.playable_objective: Draw three units at the well twice, carry each load on foot, and return six units to the household.
cards.encounter_or_choice: The second trip makes the player choose a usable, steady route with the loaded carrier; waiting during the draw offers a short exchange with another household worker.
cards.local_consequence: Water accounting follows the real draw and deposits; conversation changes local acknowledgment without producing repeatable money.
cards.cinematic_moment: The well’s rope creaks against the rim, then the frame drops to the weight of the carried vessels on the walk back.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage the draw and deposit as visible actions, add one concise worker exchange, and communicate load restrictions before the player tries to mount.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Two valid draws and deposits deliver exactly six units, load restrictions are explained in context, and interruption or reload cannot create water.

cards.title: The smith’s commission

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a promise to improve the household survive the cost and waiting that skilled work requires?
cards.playable_objective: Reserve fuel and fee, hand over the commission, return when the smith has finished, and deliver the two tools Home.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Before handover, commit the reserved resources or cancel openly; after handover, the smith gives an honest progress report rather than a second purchase.
cards.local_consequence: Cancellation releases only the pre-handover reservation; completion yields the existing two tools once and records the household’s receipt.
cards.cinematic_moment: A tool-shaped blank passes from dark workbench to furnace light; the collected pair is carried out through the same threshold later.
cards.next_implementation_task: Connect commission dialogue to the smith’s workcell staging and make reservation, work underway, collection and Home delivery distinct visible states.
cards.acceptance_criterion: All four stages read clearly, cancellation is unavailable after handover, and collecting or delivering twice cannot duplicate tools or fee deductions.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the child accept responsibility for someone else’s service without pretending to have seen what the guard saw?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the market and well requests, provision an already hired guard, dispatch him, and receive his returned accounts.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Choose which finite request to serve first; if provisions or attendance are missing, resolve those needs before ordering departure.

cards.next_implementation_task: Give the two requesters different immediate needs and add a visible departure, absence, return and report sequence around the existing service state.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Dispatch respects hire and provision requirements, both requests finish once, and returned information appears only after the player hears the guard.

cards.title: The Bhangi Bazaar Brawl

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.

cards.dramatic_question: What kind of courage will the child’s friends remember: winning a public challenge or bringing everyone home?
cards.playable_objective: Walk with Mela and Jiva to the bazaar confrontation, counter or withdraw together, then regroup and report Home.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Stand through the challenge or deliberately leave with both companions; the friends react to the choice without turning withdrawal into a failed mission.
cards.local_consequence: The local retelling and companion responses remember the chosen resolution; no route declares a wider clan uniformly hostile.

cards.next_implementation_task: Complete approach, confrontation and regroup blocking; author separate companion lines for a guarded resolution and collective withdrawal.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both resolutions complete, neither companion teleports through the encounter, and the Home report matches the actual route after save/load.

cards.title: Maha’s horsecraft lesson

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory. Speak to the stable trainer after the first riding lesson.

cards.dramatic_question: Can showmanship be disciplined enough to become a useful mounted skill?
cards.playable_objective: Complete moving single-horse balance, paired-horse balance, then mounted firing, reloading and withdrawal.
cards.encounter_or_choice: The trainer allows a controlled reset between exercises; the player chooses when to stand, settle, fire and withdraw while movement continues.
cards.local_consequence: Only each completed exercise grants its existing corresponding capability; the standalone practice scene never grants campaign skills.
cards.cinematic_moment: The paired horses briefly settle into one rhythm before the lesson changes to smoke, reload and a controlled retreat.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the three exercises separate staging and instructor reactions, strengthen mounted input feedback, and make the retreat a visible finish.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Each flag requires its own actual exercise, retrying one cannot complete another, and exiting the lesson returns Home with only earned capabilities.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

cards.title: Missing remounts

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory. Hear the quartermaster’s brief.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the young heir establish what happened to the remounts without treating suspicion as permission?
cards.playable_objective: Reach the private yard, inspect the sealed tally and both horses, then report the limited observations to the quartermaster.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Seek an introduction through the east gate, use the service gap, or observe from the ramp; witnesses react to how the boundary was crossed.
cards.local_consequence: The report distinguishes what was seen and what was read aloud; the route may create a local witness account but never a horse or cash grant.
cards.cinematic_moment: Two horses shift behind a private gate while the sealed tally remains out of reach of easy explanation.
cards.next_implementation_task: Build three legible approach routes with different witness staging and a report conversation that names the actual evidence obtained.
cards.acceptance_criterion: All three routes can deliver the required observations, unseen or unread tally content is absent from the report, and witness memory follows the route actually taken.

cards.title: The borrowed rope

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory. Listen to the quartermaster’s rope story.

cards.dramatic_question: What is owed to a story when two people remember its lesson differently?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the rope story’s variants, inspect the rope, compare the accounts, and retell a chosen version to a local listener.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Preserve one teller’s framing or openly name the disagreement; the physical rope can prompt recollection but cannot settle the story’s moral.
cards.local_consequence: The listener receives the selected attributed telling; the game stores transmission rather than declaring a canonical truth.
cards.cinematic_moment: The same length of rope passes through two different gestures as its tellers place emphasis on different parts of the memory.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage each telling with a distinct voice and object handling, then add a concise retelling response that reflects the player’s chosen attribution.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The two accounts remain distinguishable, repeat listening adds no independent corroboration, and the listener receives only the retelling actually selected.
cards.historical_basis: Explicitly fictional sakhi-inspired transmission episode.

cards.title: A funded instructor

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory. Reserve the instructor commission.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the household sustain the teacher it wants, beyond the promise of a wage?
cards.playable_objective: Reserve the commission, meet and escort the instructor, sign terms, provision the pupil, and complete funded practice.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Commit only when wages and supplies are available; during practice, recover attendance or supplies when an interruption stops progress.
cards.local_consequence: The instructor’s presence, pay and eligible teaching time determine progress; unsupported promises cannot produce trained pupils.
cards.cinematic_moment: A quiet signing at the quartermaster’s desk is followed by an ordinary drill whose pauses reveal what the contract actually costs.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the candidate a clear teaching concern, stage introduction and signing, and make paused practice explain its exact missing condition.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Commission, escort and signing occur in order; practice advances only with attendance and required supplies, and interrupted or resumed sessions do not double-charge.

cards.title: Lahore road patrol

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Main menu → Lahore · Command story.

cards.dramatic_question: How much authority can a ruler safely delegate before hearing what the road actually requires?
cards.playable_objective: Assign the patrol, control the captain or delegate the same order, inspect village and outpost, and receive the return report.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Organize the patrol or withdraw on the available observations; switching viewpoint changes control, not the number of orders or riders.
cards.local_consequence: Riders remain committed until the delayed report resolves the original order; the ruler learns only the report received.
cards.cinematic_moment: The departure order is heard at court, then the same riders appear on a quieter road where the decision has physical costs.
cards.next_implementation_task: Author a distinct road dilemma and concise village/outpost reactions around the existing command loop, keeping delegated and direct control equivalent.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both control modes resolve one shared order, no viewpoint switch duplicates riders, and the report reflects the actual patrol or withdrawal outcome.

cards.title: Mahan’s field camp

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Main menu → 1790 / Mahan Singh / Field camp (interlude).

cards.dramatic_question: What can a father still put in order when the campaign’s horizon is narrowing?
cards.playable_objective: Send scouts to ford and ridge, hear delayed reports, consult retainers, choose march or hold, and reach the fixed endpoint.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Spend time and provisions improving the account or advance with incomplete knowledge; bounded field orders change the immediate march, not the recorded death.
cards.local_consequence: The camp retains which reports arrived and which orders were issued; the father’s endpoint and chronology variant remain declared.
cards.cinematic_moment: A scout returns to find the same tent quieter; the last instruction carries farther than the father can now march.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the ford and ridge different practical risks, stage report arrival and the final handover, and connect the field prototype to a clearly marked retrospective frame.
cards.acceptance_criterion: March and hold produce distinct local supply/report histories, delayed knowledge is not available early, and every supported route reaches the declared fixed endpoint without inventing a completed father campaign.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

cards.title: Sobraon to the oral telling

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Begin through the branch’s Home launcher.

cards.dramatic_question: What does a survivor choose to carry when an army’s crossing is gone?
cards.playable_objective: Escape the Sobraon earthworks, optionally carry a wounded soldier, steer timber across the Sutlej, and approach the later surrender tableau.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Take the wounded man and accept slower movement or move alone; steer through the river’s physical obstacles before the later oral telling.
cards.local_consequence: The immediate survival presentation remembers the rescue choice; the veteran’s later knowledge does not enter the child’s 1792 state.
cards.cinematic_moment: The roar of the river cuts to the heavy silence of dropped muskets, then an oral voice carries the image into family memory.
cards.next_implementation_task: Polish danger telegraphs, wounded-carry staging, timber feedback and the transition between the three times; keep the handoff to the family introduction explicit.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both rescue choices can complete the crossing, river failure retries the bank checkpoint, skipping has a coherent handoff, and no future information or prologue supplies migrate into Home.
cards.historical_basis: Historical framing with original veteran viewpoint and authored survival actions.

cards.title: The Wedding Road

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.era: Late eighteenth century; Nakai marriage negotiations
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects delegation.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a family alliance reach the doorway without becoming a public contest over who commands it?
cards.playable_objective: Inspect the gifts, receive the delegate, escort the arrival, hear the rival messenger and return an account to the keeper.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Enter with visible ceremony or a quieter practical approach, then choose whom to alert about the rival message.
cards.local_consequence: The local arrival and final account reflect presentation and disclosure; the scene does not award the marriage or determine the bride’s life.
cards.cinematic_moment: Gift bearers pause at a threshold while a lone messenger waits just outside the procession’s rhythm.
cards.next_implementation_task: Replace the generic courtyard beats with a visible delegation, distinct gifts, rival messenger staging and an arrival reaction for each local ending.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both entry approaches remain playable, the alerted party matches the player’s choice, and the final account names only information heard during the errand.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_family_account; The source connects Bhagwan Singh's alliance through his sister with losses of territory and attempted interference. The errands, witnesses, dialogue and local outcomes are original. The prospective bride Raj Kaur is distinct from Ranjit Singh's mother.

cards.title: The Unequal Victory

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.era: 1785; a remembered coalition and its strained aftermath
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects alliance.

cards.dramatic_question: Whose sacrifice disappears when a coalition begins to tell a single story of victory?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the grievance, help the wounded companion across the passage, challenge the announcement and decide where the remaining dressings go.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Give priority to public recognition or immediate relief; the companion’s passage makes the practical cost of either emphasis visible.
cards.local_consequence: The gathering’s local account and allocation of dressings differ; no choice rewrites the coalition’s campaign result.
cards.cinematic_moment: A victory announcement continues over the sound of a wounded companion stopping halfway across the crossing.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage the wounded escort with pauses and acknowledgment, separate the announcer from the relief point, and make the final allocation visible in the scene.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The companion physically reaches the crossing marker, the selected dressings recipient is reflected in the ending, and recognition never erases the recorded political dispute.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_family_account; The book records shifting Nakai, Sukerchakia and other chief relationships, the 1785 coalition after Jai Singh's 1783 seizure, and failed reconciliation. This local escort and honour dispute is invented to make those pressures playable.

cards.title: A Stranger at the Threshold

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.era: 1790; the book's account of revenge after Wazir Singh's death
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects revenge.

cards.dramatic_question: How far can a warning protect a household when the player cannot prove what a stranger intends?
cards.playable_objective: Question the stranger, compare the gate witness, warn the steward and escort a dependent into shelter.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Give the warning as a concern or as a firmer alarm, then prioritize the dependent’s safe passage through a gathering that continues around them.
cards.local_consequence: The household response and witness wording change locally; the warning neither establishes omniscient guilt nor cancels the attributed death.
cards.cinematic_moment: The gathering remains audible as the dependent enters a narrower, quieter passage and the stranger disappears from the player’s view.
cards.next_implementation_task: Make the two accounts spatially and vocally distinct, add a time-conscious shelter walk without a false alternate-history rescue promise, and stage the report.
cards.acceptance_criterion: All permitted warnings can lead to shelter, the dependent must arrive physically, and every ending distinguishes witnessed signs from the later recorded revenge account.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_family_account; The book attributes Wazir Singh's murder to Dal Singh, son of Hira Singh of Bahrwal, and says an unnamed devoted servant later killed Dal Singh in his household. The player witnesses warning signs and shelters people; choices do not cancel that recorded death or establish omniscient guilt.

cards.title: Desi Remembers the Reins

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects desi.

cards.dramatic_question: Does an ancestor’s legend live in spectacular feats or in the horse he learned to trust?
cards.playable_objective: Mount Desi, ride the marked journey, cover the required distance, water and dismount, then choose the companion’s closing emphasis.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Let the closing telling emphasize the larger-than-life rider or the mare’s endurance; the ride remains one real mounted journey.
cards.local_consequence: The companion preserves the selected telling, while the short ride grants no proof of forty wounds or campaign horsecraft capability.
cards.cinematic_moment: The watering pause reveals the mare’s breathing and dust-marked coat after the storyteller’s sweeping claims.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give Desi a recognizable piebald appearance, shape the route into a crest and watering pause, and stage the two closing emphases with the horse present.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The route requires actual mounted travel and dismounting, both legend emphases remain available, and replay cannot grant Home training flags.
cards.historical_basis: recorded_ancestral_tradition; The book names Budha Singh's piebald mare Desi and credits him with surviving about forty wounds. This short ride, horse responses and dialogue are original. It preserves the larger-than-life ancestor without treating the ride as a documented journey.

cards.dramatic_question: What remains of a chief’s dignity when his followers need shelter more than another vow?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the elder, choose an offer from salvaged supplies, negotiate hospitality and escort a weary follower to shelter.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Offer practical relief or preserve more of the party’s portable wealth; the host responds to the offer and the follower bears the delay.
cards.local_consequence: Tonight’s hospitality and the party’s remaining supplies shape the local ending; the treasure in the well remains a narrated possibility.
cards.cinematic_moment: A follower lowers a salvaged bundle at a host’s threshold while someone behind them still speaks of revenge.
cards.next_implementation_task: Build a visibly burdened arrival, make the offered supplies tangible, and author host/follower responses that distinguish pride, need and obligation.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Each valid offer yields a coherent hospitality response, the follower reaches shelter physically, and no choice silently converts the treasure tradition into a documented player discovery.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_account_with_treasure_tradition; The source contains Ramgarhia humiliation, release with gifts, retaliatory vows, exile and a treasure-in-a-well episode. This relief errand and its choices are original, with the treasure retained as narrated possibility rather than a fabricated documented discovery by the player.

cards.title: The Water of Bahrwal

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.era: Ancestral legend; Guru Arjun and Hem Raj
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects well.

cards.dramatic_question: How does a household remember a welcome that its descendants understand as a blessing?
cards.playable_objective: Draw the first water, prepare the welcome, hear the charpai episode and blessing at the exterior threshold, then return to draw again.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Choose where to place care and attention during the welcome while the telling preserves its miraculous transformation.
cards.local_consequence: The closing reflection remembers the chosen service and sweetened water within the legend’s frame; it grants no numerical miracle bonus.
cards.cinematic_moment: The same rope returns over the well’s rim after the blessing, with the changed water held in a still, attentive pause.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the first and second draws distinct sensory presentation, stage the welcome through attendants and objects, and retain the complete miracle in the oral account.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both draws and the welcome occur in order, the miracle remains present in the telling, and the scene requires no Guru impersonation or religious-building entry.
cards.historical_basis: recorded_miracle_legend; The book records Hem Raj carrying the sleeping Guru Arjun home on a charpai, brackish water becoming sweet, and a blessing promising a powerful descendant. This adaptation preserves the miracle as the legend tells it. Dialogue and attendant errands are original; no Guru avatar, impersonation or religious-building entry is required.

cards.dramatic_question: Who can reach the young chief when every adult treats access as authority?
cards.playable_objective: Receive the audience order, hear Dal Singh’s objection, announce and escort Sada Kaur, then complete the register.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Choose how to announce the arrival and whose objection to preserve in the register; control of a doorway becomes a political act.
cards.local_consequence: Witness acknowledgment and register wording differ locally; the scene does not settle who legitimately controlled the entire regency.
cards.cinematic_moment: An audience door closes between the child and the player while rival claimants remain on opposite sides of the waiting place.
cards.next_implementation_task: Block the waiting factions as a tense, navigable audience queue and author specific reactions to the announcement and register choices.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The escort completes without bypassing the waiting dispute, register text reflects selected attribution, and the elder Dal Singh remains distinct from the Bahrwal revenge figure.
cards.historical_basis: conflicting_regency_accounts_with_original_dramatization; The Memorial records Lakhpat Rai quarrelling with Dal Singh, Maha Singh's maternal uncle, and a temporary reconciliation. Buxi supplies the household power struggle. The user-selected 1792 frame retains the project chronology beside the Memorial's 1790 succession. Sada's participation in this particular access dispute and all dialogue are original adaptations of the supplied political plot. This Dal is the elder regency figure, distinct from Dal son of Hira Singh of Bahrwal, killed in the revenge account.

cards.title: The Whisper After Midnight

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects rumours.

cards.dramatic_question: Will an accusation become a fact merely because the court writes it down?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the messenger, inspect the unsigned account, listen to the attendant, escort her to shelter and choose the night register’s wording.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Repeat the allegation with its source, record its uncertain standing, or emphasize the attendant’s direct account according to the available authored choices.
cards.local_consequence: The night’s circulation and protection of a witness shape the local ending; an affair, poisoning and guilt remain contested claims.
cards.cinematic_moment: An unsigned sheet waits under a lamp while the attendant’s quieter testimony competes with voices beyond the door.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give rumor, document and direct testimony distinct staging and journal treatment; make the attendant’s shelter and the register’s final wording visible.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The register never states an unsupported allegation as established fact, the attendant reaches shelter, and every ending preserves the source disagreement rather than deleting the dark story.
cards.historical_basis: conflicting_accusations_with_original_witness_story; Griffin repeats allegations about Raj Kaur, Lakhpat Rai and matricide, then doubts the killing stories. Buxi describes the struggle over authority and cites Sinha's rejection of Smyth's accusation. Neither establishes guilt. This night, its letter, the witnesses and every spoken line are invented. Poison remains an allegation voiced by a character, never an acquired poison item or biological finding. Timing is deliberately broad; no death in 1801 is asserted.

cards.title: Two Names in the Dispatch

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects heirs.

cards.dramatic_question: What can a courier responsibly carry when a birth announcement has already become a struggle over legitimacy?
cards.playable_objective: Receive the announcement, hear Sada Kaur’s instruction, choose how to carry the competing allegation and escort the dispatch rider to departure.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Prioritize the formal household announcement or preserve the accusation as an attributed competing account; the courier cannot adjudicate parentage.
cards.local_consequence: The dispatch’s wording and handoff differ; neither choice proves substitution, assigns biological truth or decides future succession.
cards.cinematic_moment: Two names are spoken over a dispatch being sealed while an older accusation threatens to travel with them.
cards.next_implementation_task: Create distinct announcement and rumor witnesses, make the seal and rider handoff visible, and write endings around transmission rather than a solved maternity mystery.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Each dispatch can be delivered, its wording matches the chosen treatment, and no ledger, ending or reward encodes strict primogeniture or a confirmed fabricated pregnancy.
cards.historical_basis: conflicting_birth_and_legitimacy_accounts; Griffin alleges substituted children and later political acknowledgement; the Memorial records the twins' birth announcement, thanksgiving and Mehtab's maternity. Neither the courier nor the choices establish biological truth. All dialogue, dispatch handling and minor witnesses are original. The scene preserves competing accusations without encoding strict male primogeniture or deciding future accession. Its authored 1807 frame follows the selected announcement variant and does not silently reconcile every source chronology.

cards.title: The Fortress in the Letter

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects overture.

cards.dramatic_question: How much can a threatened ruler offer before anyone on the other side is authorized to answer?
cards.playable_objective: Receive the sealed approach, consult stores, record delivery terms, meet the receiving agent and escort him through the handoff.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Carry a narrow approach or a stronger practical assurance within the scene’s choices; question the receiver about the limits of his authority.
cards.local_consequence: The delivery record captures the offer and the receiver’s limited mandate; the fort is not transferred and no alliance is concluded.
cards.cinematic_moment: The fort remains distant in the composition while the sealed packet crosses a much smaller space between two hands.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage stores, packet and receiver as three different forms of power, and give each ending a concrete receipt that stops short of acceptance.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The packet reaches the selected handoff, practical assurances match what was consulted, and every ending remains an approach delivered rather than British protection secured.
cards.historical_basis: secondary_diplomatic_account_with_original_courier_scene; The university entry records secret negotiations with British officers. Discover Sikhism describes a November 1808 offer of Atalgarh to Metcalfe tied to restoration of possessions. The packet, route, receiving agent and conditions voiced here are invented. This stage ends with an approach delivered, never a completed alliance, an invented interception or a transfer of the fort. Atalgarh here belongs to Sada's diplomatic story, not Dal Singh's Akalgarh identity.

cards.title: Behind the Lowered Curtain

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects litter.

cards.dramatic_question: What loyalty remains possible when escape has become a procession toward a closing gate?
cards.playable_objective: Receive Sada Kaur’s instruction, choose the departure account, confront Vasakha Singh and escort the bearers and covered litter to the outer entrance.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Protect the bearers’ treatment or emphasize the report’s wording while deciding how openly to confront the informing retainer.
cards.local_consequence: The party’s dignity, witness account and treatment at the last gate vary; detention remains the fixed endpoint.
cards.cinematic_moment: The lowered curtain moves with each step while the gateway ahead gradually fills the frame.
cards.next_implementation_task: Replace abstract escort markers with the litter and bearers’ synchronized movement, stage the retainer confrontation, and author distinct detention acknowledgments.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The litter and bearers reach the gate physically, local choices change the promised treatment or account, and no route advertises a successful alternate escape.
cards.historical_basis: source_attributed_escape_with_original_retainer_viewpoint; Griffin and the university entry preserve a covered-litter escape followed by detention. Discover Sikhism dates its account to 1820 and names Vasakha Singh as the informing retainer and Desa Singh as the pursuer. This 1820–1821 frame retains chronology variants. The player is a fictional additional retainer; dialogue, papers and movement choices are original. Detention is fixed. Local agency determines the treatment of bearers, the wording of a report and how the party reaches its last gate, never a successful alternate escape.

cards.title: When the Camp Falls Quiet

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects sodhra.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a child receive his father’s authority through a duty before he is ready to receive it through a title?
cards.playable_objective: Carry the father’s order, bring the veteran into evacuation work, escort him to the gate, prepare the returning party and deliver the message to Ranjit.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Give priority to the people moving out or the wording of the message within the authored choices; practical care makes the handover personal.
cards.local_consequence: The evacuation’s immediate care and remembered message differ; Maha’s illness, withdrawal and later death remain fixed in the selected chronology.
cards.cinematic_moment: The campaign’s noise recedes while a small order passes from father, to runner, to son beside an evacuation gate.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage the camp’s gradual emptying, build a visible veteran escort and supplies handover, and write the father-son message as declared original drama.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The veteran and provision stages complete before the message is delivered, each ending acknowledges the chosen care, and the scene never labels the invented exchange a documented bedside investiture.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_history_with_declared_dramatic_handover; This scene selects Griffin's 1792 illness and withdrawal, not the Memorial's 1790 child-victory outcome. The father's private words, delegated tasks, veteran, young runner, evacuation staging and choices are original drama. Authority passes through a small order to care for the camp; this is not evidence for a documented bedside investiture. Maha's death after his return remains fixed. Mana Singh is a research lead, not the identity assigned to the fictional veteran.

cards.title: Names at the Gate

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.
baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects settlement.

cards.dramatic_question: Can an agreement give a defeated household a future without demanding that it forget its dead?
cards.playable_objective: Learn the limits of your promise, hear the representative, escort the family’s reception, clarify provision and service, and settle one immediate need.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Emphasize immediate provision or the terms of service; the representative can question what the clerk’s assurances actually mean.
cards.local_consequence: A bounded household need is met and terms are recorded locally; employment does not erase bereavement or speak for every Chattha family.
cards.cinematic_moment: A family representative hesitates at the same kind of gate that once kept enemies apart, with a clerk waiting inside instead of a drawn weapon.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the representative a particular household concern, stage the clerk’s terms as a conversation and make the final provision or service arrangement visible.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The player can promise only the stated terms, the representative reaches the reception physically, and the ending preserves grief alongside the limited settlement.
cards.historical_basis: secondary_reference_with_original_local_negotiation; The entry takes the reported estates and military employment offered to Jan Muhammad's sons as its historical anchor. The unnamed family representative, veteran, clerk, guarantees, supplies, dialogue and local outcomes are original. These people speak for particular households, never every Chattha family. The sequence follows the conflict without replaying its killing; jobs and provision do not erase bereavement. The late-1790s period is separate from the 1792 opening.
